svg.title: Scheduler::Plan — four principal stages
svg.desc: PlanRequest flows through job expansion, tray assignment, AGV assignment and motion planning; each stage enriches the same ScheduleContext event DAG.

g.text: Every stage refines the result of the previous one. Simplified: several checks and branches are omitted, and this is not a ROS executor or thread schedule.
